sentences.en: "Never mind, " said Mrs. Hurstwood consolingly, "we'll go one of these days. "

sentences.en: " Well , " the old man remarked consolingly , " every bullet has its billet. "

sentences.en: But the storage/retrieval distinction also means, consolingly, that you probably haven't really forgotten your childhood French, in terms of storage strength.

sentences.en: "You've kept your complexion very well, " said Mrs. Lynde consolingly. "Of course you never had much colour to lose."

sentences.en: The round-bosomed maid came in, drew the curtains, pushed back a log, and said consolingly: "Verra--verra."
sentences.vi: Cô hầu gái tròn trịa bước vào, kéo rèm cửa, đẩy lại một khúc gỗ, và nói một cách an ủi: ""Verra - verra.""
